spellbook.finance/limitations: already_open means an unresolved return case already exists for that shipment. Its caseId is returned and no second case was written.
Each row succeeds or fails on its own. A failed row carries errorCode and wrote nothing for that session.
errorCode returned_package_session_has_several_orders means the pull sheet holds more than one order. Call again with that one sessionId and the returned order's externalOrderId.
errorCode returned_package_order_not_in_session means no line on that pull sheet carries the externalOrderId you sent.
A pull sheet holds one unresolved return case at a time. While one order's case is open, recording a second order from the same sheet fails with errorCode returned_package_case_already_open.
errorCode returned_package_idempotency_mismatch means this idempotencyKey was already used for a different returnReason or externalOrderId. Use a new key.
Recording does not refund the buyer, restock a card or relist one. A refund or restock needs the package opened and each card checked, and no tool records that yet.
Return postage and the cost of a reship label are not recorded.
The returns workflow sits behind feature flag seller_returned_packages_v1, which is on for every account today. Error feature_disabled means the flag is off for this account.
Workspace owner role is backend-enforced. This writes to the workspace you name and to no other.

annotations.title: Record a package returned to sender

description: Record that shipped packages came back to the seller unopened, such as a USPS return to sender. Pass the sessionId of each order from spellbook_returned_package_lookup and one returnReason for the batch. Each order gets one return case, held with every line unconfirmed. A reship starts from that held case. It refunds nothing, changes no inventory and touches no marketplace. Returns one row per session with status recorded, already_open or failed, the caseId, and an errorCode when it failed. To reship, call spellbook_returned_package_reship_prepare with the caseId next.

externalOrderId.description: The marketplace order id of the one returned order, as the marketplace prints it. Send it only with exactly one sessionId, when that pull sheet holds several orders. Omit it otherwise.

idempotencyKey.description: A key you choose for this batch, such as rts- followed by the order id. Required. Send the same key on a retry after a timeout. A new key on a session that already has an open case returns already_open.

returnReason.description: Why the carrier returned the packages, applied to every session in this call. address_issue means the address was wrong or incomplete, and the reship then requires a corrected address. unclaimed_or_refused covers an unclaimed or refused letter. Use unknown when the return label gives no reason. Required.

sessionIds.description: Up to 50 sessionId values from spellbook_returned_package_lookup, one per returned envelope. Required, at least one.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that shipped the orders, from spellbook_workspaces_list. Required; writes only to this workspace.

name: spellbook_returned_package_record
